title: Business Cards
slide_intent: Teach how to distribute identity and contact information across two faces of a small card. Separating roles from contact details can make a dense affiliation legible.
strategic_value: CSAIL can distinguish members of its groups while keeping both laboratory and Alliances cards within the same family.
demonstration: Three rows compare cards for different people. Contact sides show laboratory or Alliances marks, while reverse sides pair role text or the tagline with warm angular fields.
practical_value: Choose the identifier appropriate to the person’s affiliation and decide whether the reverse needs extended roles or the short tagline.

content_islands.name: Context
content_islands.spec: Set the stationery guidance at left and retain the distinction between primary and group styles.

content_islands.name: Contact faces
content_islands.spec: Stack three examples showing the identifying mark, name and contact blocks.

content_islands.name: Reverse faces
content_islands.spec: Pair each contact face with its reverse. Repeat the orange, yellow and gray geometry along the right edge.
